newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire Realty buys 3 apt communities.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire Realty buys 3 apt communities.

text.p: Berkshire Realty Co Inc said Monday it acquired three town-home apartment communities located in Glen Burnie and Millersville, Maryland.

According to a news release, the three properties were acquired for a total of $20.9 million. The price is composed of $881,000 in cash, $7.6 million of operating partnership units, and the assumption of mortgage loans insured by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), with a total outstanding balance of $12.3 million at 7.5-percent interest.

A fourth property will be purchased from the same seller, and is expected to close within 30 days, Berkshire said. The fourth property will cost $6.5 million, which is composed of about $120,000 in cash, operating partnership units worth about $1.1 million, and the assumption of a $5.3 million HUD-insured loan.
The purchase of these four properties will add 613 town-home-style units to Berkshire's portfolio, bringing the total number of multifamily units owned by the company to 13,509.
Occupancy at the acquired properties averaged 94 percent at the time of purchase.
